summary: Onboarding/Barn Setup feature validated end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 new onboarding tests PASS (steps, progress GET/PATCH/complete, barn, locations, feed-templates, inventory low_stock, recurring-schedules, staff-invites with role validation, csv-preview/commit/template for horses and owners). Overall pytest 34/35 (the 1 failure test_feed_complete is pre-existing/state-dependent, not in this iteration's scope). Frontend: login works (data-testid login-email/password/submit), sidebar 'Barn Setup' (nav-barn-setup) navigates to /onboarding which renders the 10-step wizard with stepper, Save & continue advances steps and marks them complete (green check visible), step-nav jumping between steps works (jumped step-nav-review then step-nav-barn), Existing locations list renders, Setup Progress percent is visible in the page header, Dashboard renders without Setup Progress card after onboarding/complete is called (matches spec). CSV-committed owners appeared in the Owners & Clients step roster confirming live backend↔frontend integration.

minor.issue: No corresponding endpoint/flag to UNDO completion (re-open onboarding). Once set completed=true the dashboard card disappears permanently for that user. Consider adding PATCH to reset completed=false for testing/admin override.

No duplicate-name guard on commit — if user commits twice with same rows, duplicates are inserted (preview detects them but commit does not skip). Recommend skipping rows whose name exists in db.horses for kind=horses, and same for owners email.

Silent int/float parsing — uses r.get('age','').isdigit() which fails for negative or whitespace-padded inputs and silently drops. Acceptable for MVP but consider clearer 400 on malformed numeric cells.
BarnSettings.contact_email uses EmailStr — empty string '' will 422. Frontend should send null/omit when blank (verify Onboarding.jsx does this).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='step-barn' was not found on initial mount (testids step-locations and step-review were found). This may be because the Barn Profile content uses a different testid or is rendered conditionally outside the step-{id} container. Doesn't block users but reduces testability for the first step.
Native browser <select> is used for 'Type' (Choose…) instead of shadcn/ui Select. The 'Add' button does nothing if Type is left at 'Choose…' (no inline validation error shown).

issues: Right-side 'SETUP PROGRESS 10%/20%' label is small and far from the stepper — consider co-locating with the stepper progress bar so users perceive the bar/percent as a single unit.
Native HTML <select> for Type breaks the otherwise luxury aesthetic — use the shadcn Select component for consistency with the rest of the app.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='step-barn' to Barn Profile step container in Onboarding.jsx for parity with other steps.
(Optional) Replace native <select> for Location Type with shadcn Select component.
(Optional) On /api/onboarding/csv-commit, skip duplicates server-side (use same key logic as csv-preview).
(Optional) Add a way (admin endpoint or progress PATCH supporting completed:false) to re-open onboarding for QA.
Re-run test_feed_complete after a fresh seed — current failure is state-pollution from earlier iterations marking all today's feed tasks complete.
critical_code_review_comments: ONBOARDING_STEPS percent computation correctly counts only steps with status=='complete' and divides by total step count (10) — accurate.
csv-commit horses uses isdigit() for age/wellness_score parsing which silently drops valid floats and negative numbers; consider try/except int() instead.

Onboarding progress PATCH merges body.data into existing.data via dict.update — nested objects (e.g. data['barn_draft']['name']) will be replaced wholesale instead of deep-merged. Document expectation or implement deep merge.
No authentication/role guard on /api/barn PUT — any logged-in user (even groom) can rewrite primary barn settings. Should be admin-only.
/api/staff-invites does not de-duplicate by email or guard against inviting existing users; minor for MVP but worth a note.
Mongo `_id` correctly stripped via projection/clean in all onboarding responses — good.
Inventory low_stock recomputed on each GET — correct, not persisted (avoids stale flag).

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 new onboarding tests; 34/35 overall incl. pre-existing)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all wizard flows verified; minor testid + native select cosmetic issues)

seed_data_creation: Tests created and cleaned TEST_-prefixed barn, locations, feed-templates, inventory items, schedules, staff-invites. CSV-commit created TEST_ Comet/Luna horses and TEST_ Owner One/Two owners — horses cleaned, owners left because no DELETE /api/owners may exist (verify); they will surface in Owners & Clients lists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend onboarding fully covered in /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding.py. To re-test Dashboard 'Setup Progress' card visibility for an unfinished user, either (a) seed-reset, (b) login with a different user (trainer@/groom@/owner@/vet@equinesync.com), or (c) ask main agent to expose a 'reset onboarding' admin endpoint. Note: test_progress_complete marks admin's onboarding completed=true so the dashboard card is hidden for admin afterward; this is EXPECTED per spec. CSV duplicate behavior: preview detects duplicates but commit does not skip them — flagged as minor.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs reproduced. The only test failure (test_feed_complete) is state-pollution from previous iterations: pending feed tasks have already been completed and the seed isn't re-run since users collection is non-empty. Mitigation: drop feed_tasks collection or seed with future date, then rerun.
